title: HQ reversion: h1 of (H1 pick AND the pre-2025 re-pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week with high-quality, high-probability, high-profit setups - mean reversion at exhaustion (stretched range / both sides swept / stretched into a HTF pool / failed ORB).
verdict: $500 risk, costs in. H1: 33 trades (1.29/wk), true win 60.6%, PF 1.5, net +3,000 ($492/mo), DD -1,469. H2: 20 trades (1.28/wk), true win 60.0%, PF 1.52, net +1,786 ($481/mo), DD -1,047. 2025: 91 trades (1.76/wk), true win 46.2%, PF 0.82, net -4,131 ($-336/mo), DD -6,245. 2021-24: 258 trades (1.58/wk), true win 56.2%, PF 1.18, net +10,162 ($262/mo), DD -5,147. Evals (pass/fail-or-dead %): H1 25K alone 2-wk 0.0/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 54.6/2.5; H2 25K alone 2-wk 0.0/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 53.6/0.0; 2025 25K alone 2-wk 0.0/5.6, next to LIT on the 50K 14.9/6.4; 2021-24 25K alone 2-wk 3.6/3.5, next to LIT on the 50K 16.0/10.8.
notes: tools/hq_revert.py; H1 pick AND the pre-2025 re-pick (2021-24, same gate) - both chose it

rules: Failed opening-range breakout: the 09:30-10:00 range; a 5m close beyond it, then within 3 bars a 5m close back inside the level; signal 10:00-11:30.
Trade against the swept side (short after a high, long after a low) at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop 1 tick beyond the extreme from the sweep to the signal bar (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Time exit 15:55 ET; one trade a day; $500 risk (floor(500 / (stop x $2)) micros, max 50); $1.90 a micro + 1 tick on entries, stop and time exits.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
